experiment: Exp 15A: full 64-layer true-causal TFQ3-4b vs shipped HF-INT4-G16-BC on frozen WikiText-2/Code windows

meta.gpu_assignment: container-visible xpu:0 backed exclusively by host GPU1 (<card-node> <render-node>)
meta.reference_validation: Pinned sdpa before standalone layer construction; final normalized BF16 hidden states required max_abs_diff==0.0 against exp11_cache.pt and BF16 PPL exactly 7.79822 WT2 / ~=2.374 Code.

tfq_residual_inventory.semantic_note: TFQ residual RMSNorm tensors are actual scales; HF Qwen3.5 parameters are actual_scale-1 because Qwen3_5RMSNorm.forward multiplies by (1+weight). linear_attn.norm is gated RMSNorm and is direct. TFQ conv1d weights use [C,K,1] and are transposed to HF [C,1,K] for the as-shipped arm.

startup_verification.hfg16_dequant_formula: int8=q*u from xe2_dpas_native_v1; Wrot=int8*d_row; logical W=unrotate_Had128NoPerm(Wrot); exact shipped bias_corr sidecar

meta.dtype_scope: Quantization-quality oracle harness: packed formats are logically decoded and substituted into the same BF16 causal transformer stream. W4A8 arms use FP32 Hadamard rotation, per-token absmax/127 scaling, RNE int8 activations, exact int8xint8 accumulation, and FP32 epilogue. TFQ BiasCorr uses strict disjoint mixed calibration with position 0 excluded; HFG16 arms use the checkpoint's exact shipped bias_corr tensors.
meta.body_sharing_disclosure: No transformer body sharing is used. TFQ3_4b_as_shipped has its own stream because TFQ residual embedding/weights are BF16 but not bit-identical to local BF16, and TensorFold stores actual RMSNorm scales whereas HF stores scale-1. BF16_body_with_TFQ3_lm_head reuses exact BF16 hidden states by design.
